# atlassian_jira_project_permission_scheme (Data Source)

Look up the permission scheme currently attached to a Jira project.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_key` (String) Project key or ID.

### Read-Only

- `scheme_id` (String) Attached permission scheme ID.
- `scheme_name` (String) Attached permission scheme name.
